dex.entry: A vast solar disc-ray that has doubled in size and brightness, now trailing twelve long luminous rays that each end in a focused point of concentrated daylight capable of cutting stone. A creature shaped exactly like the sun — ancient, enormous, and utterly unmatched in the flooded dark.

art.silhouette: Wide disc silhouette, now with a visible central eye that pulses golden; twelve long ray-trails fan out in all directions, each tipped with a bright point; at 64px it fills the frame like a living sun glyph.
